corrected_prompt:
Premium studio claymation scene - everything sculpted from matte plasticine with refined intentional craftsmanship: subtle tool marks, controlled texture, soft rounded geometry, slight subsurface warmth, macro lens feel with shallow depth of field, soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle rim glow, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the miniature clay world. Vertical 9:16 frame. Palette (every colour in this frame): warm cream #F3E9D8, terracotta #C8553D, sage #8FA98B, deep ink #2B2A33, heart red #D64545.

References: none attached (text to image).

Camera: straight on, square to the screen, camera inside the miniature clay world; macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16. One subject: the booking page, edge to edge, big.

Subject and props: A macro close-up of one clay phone screen, seen square on: the screen's rounded top edge with a terracotta #C8553D clay rim runs straight across the frame at 30% of the frame height, and the screen continues past the left, right and bottom edges of the frame. The screen is matte clay, not glass, no reflections. From the top edge down to 30% of the frame height there is only plain cream #F3E9D8 clay. On the screen, edge to edge: a cream #F3E9D8 band from 30.5% to 37% of the frame height holding the words, with a thin deep ink #2B2A33 clay line along its bottom edge; under it a plain sage #8FA98B screen field that continues to the bottom edge of the frame. The calendar: 2 rows by 4 columns of big plain cream clay tiles with sage gaps, each tile a rounded rectangle about twice as wide as tall, from 8% to 78% of the frame width and 39% to 48% of the frame height, every tile empty: no digits, no names, no marks. Under the calendar, a low pile, one to two hearts high, of plump thumb-pressed clay hearts in heart red #D64545, each about 6% of the frame width, from 8% to 60% of the frame width and 50% to 55% of the frame height, not touching the calendar. The sage field continues plain to the right of the calendar and the hearts, and everywhere lower than 55% of the frame height.

Hands: no hands visible.

Action as contact points: The screen faces the camera square on; the hearts lie flat against the screen surface in one low pile under the calendar, each resting on the screen or on the heart under it; nothing touches the band, the letters or the calendar tiles.

Text: heavy bold capital letters, exactly: "BOOK A CALL" on the cream band at the top of the screen, deep ink #2B2A33 letters, centred, at x 14% to 86%, y 31.5% to 36%; nothing covers any letter. No other text anywhere.

Setting and background: the clay phone screen fills the frame from 30% of the height down; from the top edge to 30% only plain cream clay; lower than 55% only the plain sage screen field. no signs, frames, posters or other screens; the only writing is the quoted text.

Layout (STANDARDS 6; heights measured down from the top edge of the frame): the top 30% of the frame is plain and empty (the text hook is set at 14% to 30% in the edit); every key element sits between 30% and 55% of the frame height (captions start at 55%) and inside 6% to 94% of the width, and inside 6% to 79% of the width wherever it lies lower than 50% of the height; lower than 55% there is only the plain continuation of the surface, nothing else.

Continuity: first frame of the reel; nothing carried over.

Negatives: no logo, wordmark or real app name or app icon anywhere; no digits or numbers anywhere; no words other than the quoted ones; nothing in the top 30% of the frame (measured down from the top edge) except the plain surface; no people, no hands, no faces; no workbench, table edge or room around the clay world; no glossy CGI look, no glass reflections.

Everything in frame is real professionally sculpted matte plasticine, photographed - refined sculpting marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
